![text](25,24,468,139) correctly: ‘What do you think Jenny will do next?’ ‘It’s hard to tell.’ ◊ I could tell that he had enjoyed the evening. ◊ You can never tell what he’s going to say next. ◊ I can’t tell the difference between Dan’s sisters. 4 [T] (used about a thing) to give information to sb: This book will tell you all you need to know. 5 [I] to not keep a secret: Promise you won’t tell! 6 [I] ~ (on sb/sth) to have a noticeable effect: I can’t run as fast as I could – my age is beginning to tell!
